bootstrap.unit: whole seed, all opponents and both seats together; mirror excluded from primary

development_gate: One candidate only. Positive paired profit in BOTH development seed clusters and primary mean margin/score nonnegative, no storage loss/non-SELL opportunity regression. Otherwise stop with negative result; no test reading.
promotion_gate: Primary paired profit 95% lower bound > 0 AND mean gain >= 1% baseline net profit AND mean margin/score deltas >= 0 AND market subgroup mean profit/margin/score deltas >= 0 AND all execution, replay, preservation/privacy checks pass. Point subgroup checks are not noninferiority evidence.
failure_policy: No test seed replacement, candidate retuning or reuse. Repeats excluded. Preserve infrastructure failures separately.
scope: Only SELL choices; same-observation units and non-SELL order slots/quantities unchanged. Economic feedback may change later inputs. No BC or GPU training.
